name: Northwest Chimney
overview: A serious three-pitch rock line up Cascade Peak's northwest side, approached from the C-J col; loose rock and minimal fixed protection make it a rarely-repeated, committing alternative to the East Ridge scramble.
beta: Graded 5.8, the Northwest Chimney climbs three pitches of broken, loose rock - including an aesthetic but sparsely-protected chimney pitch - from the moat below the peak's northwest side to the summit. Loose rock can make the crux first pitch feel considerably harder than that grade (closer to 5.10), and no rappel anchors, pitons or summit register have been reported, which suggests the route sees very few ascents.
descent_text: From the summit, downclimb/simul-climb back to the top of the technical pitches and rappel the route on gear-built nut/cam anchors. Allow roughly 4.5 hours from the summit back to the C-J col.
descent: Rappel the route on gear-built anchors (no fixed anchors documented).
rappels: Rappel the route on gear-built anchors - no fixed rap stations have been reported. Allow roughly 4.5 hours from the summit back to the C-J col.

pitch_detail.notes: From the moat below the northwest side, climb a badly broken, loose crack of roughly 5-6 inches that takes very little protection — bring slings and a few nuts, and test every hold. Grades given for this pitch range from 5.8 to 5.10, the loose rock making it climb well above its published grade. The exact start is poorly defined, so identify the chimney above before committing.
An aesthetic chimney with almost no protection unless a very large cam or tube chock (Big Bro size) is carried. A pack is awkward in it; plan how to carry or clip it before starting.
The last roped pitch is technically easy but very loose; use smaller solid holds rather than the big blocks. It ends at a false summit.

Continue from the false summit to the true summit on loose ground, which can be simul-climbed. There are no fixed anchors, slings or pitons anywhere on the route, so every rappel on the way down is built from your own gear.
